jurisdiction.name: Democratic People's Republic of Korea
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Official North Korean state websites could not be accessed during this review, and no official AI law, strategy, regulator guidance or ministry document could be found as published text. AI appears only in leadership statements reported by state media, such as remarks in 2025 describing AI as a priority for military drones.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but the official state portals could not be accessed, so the finding that no official AI governance documents exist rests on web searches only. North Korea is marked for a later retry.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp returned HTTP 503 to curl and WebFetch on every attempt; searches in Korean and English found no official AI text. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: searched, nothing found: no official DPRK law, decree or Supreme People's Assembly (Standing Committee) decision on AI or with explicit AI provisions located; no accessible official gazette; official state portals kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp unreachable (curl and WebFetch both failed); Government: searched, nothing found: no published national AI strategy, programme or governance framework; only state-media reports of leadership statements (e.g. September 2025 remarks prioritising AI for military unmanned systems), which are not policy documents; Ministries: searched, nothing found: no ministry-level AI documents (education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour, interior, State Commission of Science and Technology) published online; Regulators: searched, nothing found: no data protection authority, cyber security agency or sector regulator publishing AI guidance exists in accessible form. Not reached: kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp (official state portals) could not be reached directly; the absence finding rests on web search plus failed direct access. Could not verify: kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp returned HTTP 503 via curl and WebFetch. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.
